lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the branchial region, extending toward the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, creating high-contrast anchor nodes primarily in the mid-lateral section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from light-reflective dorsal surface to shadowed ventral surface.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse distribution of approximately 6-10 small high-luminance blobs is visible on the lateral surface of the truncated dorsal fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The first dorsal fin exhibits a blunt, truncated morphology lacking a pointed apex. A distinct white, elongated biological attachment is visible at the distal trailing edge of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly atypical low-profile dorsal fin silhouette, appearing significantly shorter and more rounded than standard species morphology.
